title: New NES Tetris Technique: Faster Than Hypertapping!
summary: aGameScout explains rolling, the third major NES Tetris playstyle, in which players tap the back of the controller to move pieces faster than hypertapping. It covers how the technique works and where it comes from.
why: HN points to it as the concise explanation of the latest competitive NES Tetris technique.

quote.text: fascinating 9-minute YouTube video that explains the latest NES Tetris competitive tech
